jobs.description: Job Title: Executive Producer - Call of Duty Requisition ID: R028234 Job Description: Job Title : Executive Producer Reporting To: Senior Director of Production Department : Production Location: Santa Monica, CA Your Platform Founded in 1979, Activision has continuously disrupted the world of entertainment as a leader in the videogame industry. With a history of delivering iconic game changers -- like Pitfall® , Tony Hawk®, Guitar Hero®, Crash Bandicoot™, Skylanders ™ and Call of Duty ® -- our obsession is delighting our players around the globe. Focused and committed to innovation, we consistently deliver the most beloved, engaging and successful entertainment. And while we have world-class franchises, infrastructure and resources, our success comes from a passionate, talented and diverse team of people producing greatness together. So, if you’re interested in our biggest priority, it’s our people. We’re currently driving the next era for our company and community by creating amazing experiences for fans and continuing to make Activision an inclusive place where everyone can thrive. Join us, make history. To learn more, check us out at www.activision.com , www.activisiongamesblog.com or @Activision on Instagram, Twitter, Facebook and LinkedIn. Your Mission Activision Publishing is currently looking for an Executive Producer to join the Call of Duty franchise production team. We are looking for an individual who has a passion and proven track record of leading production initiatives. As Executive Producer, you will manage production initiatives on one or multiple projects across various platforms from both a business and publishing perspective. You will partner with both internal and external studios in a wide range of areas to achieve franchise initiatives as well as attain financial and schedule goals. This entails day-to-day involvement with the development teams and key publishing stakeholders throughout all phases of development, including pre-production, production, submission, and release. Specific duties include: working with teams to build out initiative requirements, goals, and roadmaps; ensure milestones are delivered on-time and the game meets quality standards; help maintain creative vision; track overall development; and work closely with all developers and cross-functional groups to deliver initiatives, activations, and digital content to meet all project and franchise goals. You will guide and advance Call of Duty as you work with all Studios and Business Partners. This role will continuously iterate on best practices across all the franchise games, adapting with the business. You will be a project leader, and work in with multiple cross-functional groups, ranging from Activision executive leadership to development studios, and use your experience on the front lines to improve production and organizational processes, as well as drive key franchise initiatives with both developers and internal department leads. This position is based in our Santa Monica, California office and follows an in-office work model of four days per week. Working arrangements may evolve based on business needs. Your responsibilities will include Manage and track game development with internal / external studios across all SKUs of production initiatives tied to a mainline product and its digital life-cycle. Support the creation, development, and execution of production initiatives, projects, pathways, and overall plan; continue to provide supervision and support through full operations life-cycle Collaborate with business partners and studios to provide players with a steady stream of compelling features, content, and events Partner with monetization and analytics teams to understand the game’s status and plan updates accordingly Act as primary point of contact with Game Development Studios, 1st Parties, Marketing, PR, Operations, Sales, Supply Chain, Licensors, and external contractors across project initiatives Partner with Marketing to execute plans for the product lines, brands, and lines of business Partner with Developers to ensure specific game features are tied to overall title positioning and goals Be an internal and external advocate for the product and support as needed at trade shows and PR events. Coach and develop staff to ensure growth and expand the talent base Create a culture that promotes collaboration, continuous feedback, support and empowerment. Set clear goals for the team and hold employees accountable for deliverables; recognize and reward employees for strong performance Establish model behavior that supports Activision’s standards of professionalism, integrity, and ethics Provide creative and executional direction to development studios to improve product quality and drive franchise innovation. Ensure the titles and franchise maintain or exceed creative and technical objectives with each release What you bring to the table Proven Executive Producer with either internal development or publishing experience who delivers projects to quality, on time and budget. 10+ years of experience in the gaming industry (in a production role); experience with First Person Shooters or Online FPS preferred with 3+ years of experience at Senior Producer level or above. The ability to identify risks early and often and suggest mitigation strategies that are thought through and take into account multiple paths to a solution. A Leader of People. Be prepared to lead, mentor and develop future leaders. You are knowledgeable about games and trends in the industry ranging from other competitive FPS titles, Monetization, E-Sports and other ways games are expanding beyond the core mainline experience. Collaborator & Communicator You speak other languages; specifically, the languages of marketing, PR, Sales, QA, Customer Service, Localizations, Tech, Monetization, CRM, etc. Producing the game is only part of the job. You’ll collaborate with a wide variety of groups and people. Experience effectively collaborating with internal teams and development studios within the video game industry. You will only be as successful as your relationship with the development teams allows. You will be the main point of contact for one of the biggest entertainment franchises in the world and requires best in class and timely communications across all mediums (emails, phone, meetings, presentations, etc.) Gamer Who Knows How to Make a Game Great You are passionate about making video games. Ability to evaluate and judge gameplay in its current state and its trajectory towards close. Can identify what plays and looks good and how to drive improvements toward greatness by leveraging qualitative assessments. Experience identifying the strengths and weakness in a game and knowing when to marshal resources to lean into strengths or address weaknesses. Strategist with the Skills to Execute Strong business/financial acumen and understanding of current business models in gaming Never afraid to roll up your sleeves to get the job done Facilitator who clear roadblocks in front of your team or the development team Able to juggle competing priorities and timelines Able to break down impossible tasks and make them possible through ingenuity, creativity, and effort. The Skills & Experience we’re looking for: Bachelor’s Degree or higher education degree preferred 10+ years of experience in the gaming industry (in a production role) 3+ years of experience at Sr. Producer level or above Experience shipping 3+ high quality titles Experience shipping on Xbox, PlayStation, and PC platforms. Experience with online FPS games preferred. Our World At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences. We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization. We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up. Ready to Activate Your Future? We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply. jobs.description: Job Description Summary GE Aerospace’s Batesville Composites Operations in Batesville, Mississippi, is a 330,000 square-foot manufacturing facility with approximately 315 employees. GE Aerospace is the world's largest provider of jet engines. At Batesville Composites Operations we manufacture Polymer Matrix Composites, which are a lightweight alternative to conventional manufactured metals. We are also the second GE shop in the world to manufacture Ceramic Matrix Composites, which are some of the most advanced composites technology in existence, providing both weight and thermal advantages for an engines core. Not only do we manufacture parts from raw materials but also procure over 2000 piece parts and components to perform jet engine assembly on the fan stator module, which makes up 50% of a commercial jet engine. The Materials Planner will support the Composites Value Stream at the Batesville, MS site by coordinating the flow of raw materials, components, and production requirements to ensure alignment with manufacturing schedules and customer delivery commitments. This role is responsible for planning and scheduling material needs, maintaining system accuracy, and partnering across supply chain, operations, sourcing, and quality to support reliable execution in a dynamic manufacturing environment. The position plays a key role in driving inventory optimization, schedule attainment, and continuous improvement across the value stream. Job Description Roles and Responsibilities: Coordinate and expedite the flow of materials from suppliers and within internal operations to support the Composites Value Stream production plan. Develop, maintain, and update production schedules, material plans, and purchasing requirements to ensure on-time availability of materials and uninterrupted manufacturing flow. Partner closely with operations, sourcing, quality, logistics, and manufacturing teams to resolve material shortages, schedule changes, and execution issues that may impact delivery or production performance. Manage master planning activities, material systems, and ERP transactions to maintain accurate demand, supply, inventory, and production data. Monitor and support key performance indicators such as on-time delivery, schedule attainment, inventory health, material availability, and past due orders. Drive inventory optimization while balancing production continuity, lead times, and customer requirements. Identify and support process improvement opportunities across planning, material flow, and value stream execution to improve responsiveness, reduce waste, and enhance operational performance. Apply a working knowledge of planning processes, materials management, and manufacturing operations to support daily execution and solve routine planning issues. Use judgment within established procedures to adjust priorities and sequencing based on changing production needs, material constraints, and business conditions. Communicate planning priorities, risks, and recovery actions clearly to stakeholders and escalate issues as needed to support business objectives. Support a team environment through effective collaboration, strong interpersonal skills, and a continuous improvement mindset. Minimum Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university (or a high school diploma/GED with a minimum of 4 years manufacturing/materials/supply chain experience) Desired Characteristics: Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Experience in manufacturing, supply chain, materials planning, or production control. Experience supporting an aerospace, composites, or other highly regulated production environment. Familiarity with Lean principles, continuous improvement, and value stream operations. Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
You will play a critical role in scaling our revenue by managing complex deals and developing standardized processes that balance speed with control. You'll work at the intersection of finance, sales, legal, and compliance teams to ensure our products reach customers to support Anthropic's rapid growth. Quarterback deals through internal processes — CPQ quote-building, approval routing, contract execution — ensuring accurate, timely completion

Track and analyze deal patterns to identify bottlenecks and propose data-driven improvements to our sales operations

Are comfortable both executing within existing systems (CPQ, SFDC, contract platforms) and improving those systems as you go

Your safety matters to us.

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
